propositions: transition_issue_by_name matches requested name against transition name but callers pass destination status name, causing lookup to fail when transition and status names differ
on classic Jira workflow, transition names differ from status names (e.g. 'Start Progress' transitions to 'In Progress'), while on Cloud workflow they coincide, making the bug invisible on Cloud
when transition lookup fails, ValueError is caught and soft-failed into bridge_alerts causing pass to exit 0 without applying status change, appearing as silent partial failure
transition_issue_by_name should resolve requested name against destination status (to.name field) as fallback after checking exact transition name match
error messages must list both available transition names and their destination statuses to aid debugging
